title: Camp Kindle

services.name: Yoga Retreats
services.desc: Our camp offers a variety of facilities that are well suited for yoga and meditation group retreats. You have the opportunity to practice yoga in our reflection garden, which is rooted in spirituality and gratitude. If you’d prefer an indoor space, our beautiful and newly renovated music hall, with large windows facing Silver Creek is a tranquil and restorative location. We understand the importance that food plays in nourishing the body and the soul, and we guarantee you’ll enjoy the healthy and delicious meals prepared by our amazing kitchen team; we have no doubt, you’ll be coming back for seconds!
